summary: This Higher Side Chats interview is the central current source for the story-virus seed: Jiang frames Sabbatai Zevi and Jacob Frank as a hidden grammar of modern power where redemption-through-sin, taboo inversion, narrative infection, elite continuity, transhumanist immortality, and catastrophe survival move through stories that remake conscience.

existing_lens_links.rationale: This is the source's strongest lens contribution and the current central evidence for the held Story Virus child candidate.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The episode read already links Jiang's catastrophe advice away from elite bunkers and toward neighbors, spirituality, community, creativity, and shared imagination.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Human Heart owns this when the active mechanism is relational and spiritual resilience after money, geography, and private exit stop carrying safety.

new_lens_seeds.title: Story Virus And Remade Consciousness
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A memorable story, song, or myth repeats inside consciousness until it changes what the person treats as natural, guiltless, or possible, then travels through people and institutions as a self-reproducing moral world.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism explains Frankist story-magic, operative myths, poetry-memory, screen-world feedback, and end-times scripts without collapsing them into one topic page.
